gen-gf-phudu-gf-almendra-sc: Phudu's pipe-like strokes give it a chunky, bold look, with the same plain line weight on every curve; Almendra SC follows in small-capped dignity.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-antic-slab: Antic Slab reads dignified and editorial, its round bowls drawn with a uniform wall, while Phudu stands above it, bold and open at every curve. Both are plainspoken in their own way.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-arvo: Traditional in temperament, Arvo keeps its curves from ever closing up, which gives paragraphs a dignified, open texture. Phudu does the loud work of announcing; Arvo does the patient work of carrying.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-belgrano: Belgrano reads classic and traditional, its open-mouthed curves staying clear from word to word, under a Phudu heading with bowls as heavy as its stems. Phudu announces; Belgrano settles in.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biorhyme-expanded: BioRhyme Expanded reads refined and bookish, with wide gaps that let each letter stand alone and an open e you can see through. Phudu's bold display letters handle the shouting, and this serif keeps a long page unhurried.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-biz-udmincho: BIZ UDMincho brings a bookish, traditional text serif with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps between letters. And Phudu's solid, unshifting line weight sits above it as the bold, distinctive voice.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-copse: Phudu draws every letter with a flat, unvarying line weight and generous openings on each curve, which makes it bold and distinctive. It earns its keep big and short, above Copse.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-cutive: Phudu is bold and distinctive, a display face whose steel-cable outline never shifts from thick to thin in any letter. And Cutive follows with wide-tracked, literary serif text, best given room.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-david-libre: David Libre reads dignified and refined, its terminals hanging open so each word feels unhurried beside Phudu's uninterrupted line width. Bold display up top, a settled text serif below.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-enriqueta: Literary and dignified, Enriqueta's chalky curves stop well before closing. Phudu's stroke weight never varies, so its bold display letters sit above that soft text serif like a poster over a paperback.
